architecture.selected_approach: Minimal State Machine with Facade — keep 12 states (AD2), simplify execution to 5 phases (PARSE→GENERATE→VALIDATE→TEST→COMMIT), use plain functions everywhere except pipeline.py and engine.py
architecture.rejection_rationale: Pragmatic review found 8 GoF patterns across 10 modules = pattern-over-engineering for a single-developer local tool. Revised to 2 patterns + dataclasses. Plain functions for context, generation, validation, testing, committing, state persistence, and events.

bounded_contexts.name: Engine Facade
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Public API: run(), step(), status(), cancel(). Hides all internal complexity.

bounded_contexts.name: Pipeline State Machine
bounded_contexts.responsibility: 12-state machine with validated transitions, checkpoint, resume, cancel.

bounded_contexts.name: Context Builder
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Read project files, detect framework, assemble context for code generation.

bounded_contexts.name: Code Generator
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Build prompt via prompt_compiler, call BeeLlama via transport, extract code blocks.

bounded_contexts.name: Validator
bounded_contexts.responsibility: 4-stage validation in sequence: AST → syntax → imports → execution.

bounded_contexts.name: Test Runner
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Run pytest via transport, parse results.

bounded_contexts.name: Committer
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Branch, write files, commit, push via transport.

bounded_contexts.name: State Persistence
bounded_contexts.responsibility: SQLite persistence for engine_runs and engine_task_results tables.

bounded_contexts.name: Event Bridge
bounded_contexts.responsibility: If on_event callback is set, call it. Otherwise no-op. 5 lines.

retry.GENERATE: max 3, each retry adds error context
retry.TEST: max 2 fixes, each adds test failure output

NFR3.gate: Design guideline: don't do heavy I/O in checkpoints

NFR7.gate: Unit test: transport called once in __init__

NFR8.gate: Unit test: each stage catches its error type

decision_log.decision: Hybrid Minimal State Machine with Facade
decision_log.rationale: Preserves 12-state observability (AD2) while simplifying execution loop. Facade pattern for engine.py. Plain functions for all other modules.
Pragmatic review found pattern-over-engineering. 8 GoF patterns in 10 modules is enterprise scale for a single-developer local tool. Keep State Machine + Facade, use plain functions everywhere else.

decision_log.decision: VALIDATION PASS: simulation + red-team found 20+ concrete breaks that document-only audits missed
decision_log.rationale: Critical: unsandboxed exec of LLM code, files never written before pytest (TEST tested nothing), path traversal via task.module, HTTPTransport sends no auth token (real codebase bug), Rule-6 violation (merged SQLite DBs). ALL patched in artifacts — see VALIDATION_REPORT.md.
rejected_alternatives: Skipping simulation because 3 prior audits passed
decision_log.meta_lesson: Document-only audits systematically over-pass. Every future review gate MUST include (a) code-anchored API checks against the real codebase and (b) a traced execution simulation against goals.

decision_log.decision: VALIDATION PASS 2: code-vs-contract diff found 2 implementation killers + 1 bug + 8 gaps (C1-C11); all fixed
decision_log.rationale: C1: BeeLlama response is FLAT (total_tokens/thinking_tokens) not nested usage — 0-token corruption. C2: NO write_file exists on any transport — write_project_file() base64 helper is the single write path. C5: regex parser was a DOWNGRADE of existing PRDParser — now bridged (PRDParser first, regex fallback). C3 docker_exec arg bug, C4 prd_result shape, C6 Task.files list, C8 engine.db schema_version, C9 streaming bridge. All patched — see VALIDATION_REPORT.md.
rejected_alternatives: Adding transport.write_file in Phase 1 (optional, helper suffices)

Added: mission anchor (ARCHITECTURE.md §0 quoting AGENTS.md lines 3 and 9), goal-trace table (10 mission clauses → design sections + acceptance gates), Epic 5 Phase 2 stub (EPICS.md lines 137–158), self-scoring contract (contracts/self-scoring-benchmark.yaml, 510 lines), parent-layer anchoring (EPICS.md Mission section). decision_log.decision: Ticket-ledger state machine + backtest design authored; propagated to all lateral project files
decision_log.rationale: Two new authoritative designs were authored to close Phase 2 coverage gaps: (1) TICKET-STATE-MACHINE.md — the ticket-ledger state machine with bounded fix loops, escalation gates, and atom-level trace integration; (2) BACKTEST-DESIGN.md — atom-level replay making every engine run deterministic and bisectable offline without GPU. Both designs share an atom model: campaign atoms (ticket-machine gates) and engine atoms (pipeline transitions) use the same replay/forensics tooling. Propagated into EPICS.md (Epic 6 stub with 4 user stories + 3 acceptance criteria), ARCHITECTURE.md (engine/trace.py as Phase-2 module + determinism contract), PRE_PRD.md (AC6.1–AC6.3 verification gates), VALIDATION_REPORT.md (design pass section), and orchestration-layer-design.md (ACE section extended).
rejected_alternatives: Implementing backtest in Phase 1 (blocked on unified engine)
Separate atom models for campaign vs engine atoms (divergence risk)
decision_log.meta_lesson: When two new designs share a core concept (atom model), propagate them together into the lateral files to keep the cross-references tight and avoid drift.
